name: AgMission
program: AgMission climate-smart and regenerative agriculture research RFAs (with PepsiCo, McDonald's and other Founding Partners)
collect_note: AgMission has no standing call list (its Open Opportunities block on the Our Work page says none are open); when a new RFA opens it is announced in the news section of agmission.org (as the 2023 PepsiCo RFA was), so the twice-daily run reads the first page of that news archive, keeps only items whose title announces a call, and reads each announcement page for a 'due <Month D, YYYY>' closing date. Calls wait as hidden candidates for review.
